verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an external-authorizer mode in which the client's own system authorizes and adjusts each transaction without Pomelo's credit core or authorizer. That covers the 'my system approves each authorization' half of just-in-time funding. It also documents stand-in authorization for when the client's services are slow, and digital accounts that could hold balances, but nothing explicitly describes a prefunded-balance funding model or lets a buyer choose between the two. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented prefunded-balance option, explicit per-authorization funding (not just approval) in the external-authorizer flow, documentation of cash-flow tradeoffs between models, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented
